text.content:
The entertainment heart of the north side, and the Claws' money street.

Region: Westbrook (district G). Was: Upper Marina, the north of Old Japantown
Controlled by: The Tyger Claws, openly; the NCPD's Japantown substation closes at ten
The feel of it: Neon, lanterns, dollhouses and noodle bars; Corporate-safe on the main drags
Notable locations: Jig-Jig Street (#10), Cherry Blossom Market (#11), Clouds (#12), Fourth Wall Studios (#13), the Moon Garden, City Medical Center (#58), the old Ziggurat tower (#59), REO Meatwagon (#60), Highcourt Plaza Hotel (#61)
Danger: Moderate / Corporate. SC 6 (Kimen-Gumi and NCPD, Hardened Light). UC 3

Corpos come down from the hill for Jig-Jig Street and the clubs under H8, the city's best megabuilding and priced like it; tourists come for the glass-roofed market. The Japanese diaspora that moved north from Kabuki lives here with club workers, joytoys, chefs and musicians, and young corpos enjoying the "authentic" streets before moving up the hill. The Claws' lanterns hang outside every shop that pays; every dollhouse on Jig-Jig has a Mox doorman or a Mox friend.

Recent History

  • 2047: On the second night after Static Night, the cult of Roxanne floods the streets around Ziggurat HQ in Upper Marina. The tower's sub-basements are sealed afterward. Old Japantown burns in the Purge-Riot.
  • 2050s: The diaspora moves north into Upper Marina, and the Japantown name moves with it.
  • 2051: Ziggurat goes bankrupt. Night Corp buys the tower and moves the CitiNet in; NetWatch takes the top floors.
  • 2070: Shinobu the Third takes the Claws and closes two Claw dollhouses on Jig-Jig.

Places

  • Cherry Blossom Market (#11). SC 7. A glass roof, a real cherry tree, and Claw-blessed fences in the back stalls.
  • Clouds (#12). SC 8: Tyger Claws. The most expensive dollhouse in the city, in H8: doll-chipped companions, perfect discretion, very good blackmail files.
  • Fourth Wall Studios (#13). SC 7. Most of the city's legitimate braindance, and a lot of the other kind.
  • City Medical Center (#58). SC 9. A corporate hospital taking insurance, Trauma Team subscribers and cash.
  • Highcourt Plaza Hotel (#61). SC 8. Five stars, a Claw-owned bar, and a concierge who can get you anything.

Getting There

NCART: Japantown, Silk Road (Crosstown, Central Loop, Star Line, Westbrook Express).

Turf

Tyger Claws. The Mox on Jig-Jig Street.

People

  • Shinobu the Third (Ganger 9). Leader of the Tyger Claws.
  • Wakako Okada (Fixer 8). Westbrook's top fixer.
  • Hoshi Tanabe (Media 5). Ziggurat's last head of PR, now writing Night Corp press releases in the same building.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.09
